chunks: Muhammad bin Hammam said: Abdullah bin Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us, saying: Muhammad bin Eesa bin Obayd narrated to us, from Muhammad bin Abu Ya'qob al-Balkhi, who said: I heard Abul Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying:

You will be tried with what is harder and greater, you will be tried with the fetus in its mother's womb and the suckling until it is said: he has disappeared and died. And they will say: There is no Imam. And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) has disappeared, and disappeared, and here I am dying as well.
ai.seo_question: What test regarding the Imamate and young children did Imam al-Rida predict?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) predicts a profound period of tribulation where the death of young children, who have not yet reached the age of accountability, will cause the Shia to cry out 'No Imam' due to the apparent absence of leadership. He contextualizes this by linking it to the earlier disappearance of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his own impending death, illustrating the gradual transition of authority and the continuity of the Imamate despite physical concealment. This narration highlights the psychological and spiritual crisis of the 'Minor Occultation' era, where the faithful must maintain conviction in the unseen Imam amidst severe trials.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (27) Muhammad bin Hammam narrated from Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari from Muhammad bin Eessa bin Obayd that Muhammad bin Abu Ya’qoob al-Balkhi had heard Abul Hasan ar-Redha (as) saying:

“You are going to be tried with a great test. You are going to be tried with the fetus while still in its mother’s womb and with the suckling until it is said: he has disappeared and he has died. They say: “There is no Imam.” The Prophet (S) has disappeared and disappeared and I am going to die as well.”
